command:
set -euo pipefail
sudo python3 - <<'PY'
import json,urllib.parse,urllib.request
local=[]
for l in open('/var/log/kubernetes/audit.log'):
 try: e=json.loads(l)
 except ValueError: continue
 o=e.get('objectRef',{})
 if o.get('name')=='audit-capacity-probe' and (o.get('subresource')=='token' or e.get('verb')=='patch'):
  local.append(e)
assert any(e['objectRef'].get('subresource')=='token' for e in local)
assert any(e['verb']=='patch' for e in local)
for e in local:
 if e['objectRef'].get('subresource')=='token': assert e['level']=='Metadata' and 'responseObject' not in e
 q=urllib.parse.urlencode({'query':'_time:30m "'+e['auditID']+'"','limit':5})
 rows=[json.loads(s) for s in urllib.request.urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:9471/select/logsql/query?'+q,timeout=20).read().decode().splitlines()]
 assert rows, e['auditID']+' missing centrally'
 for r in rows:
  assert r['k8s.cluster.name']=='mothership'
  if e['objectRef'].get('subresource')=='token': assert r['audit.level']=='Metadata' and 'responseObject' not in json.loads(r['_msg'])
 print({'auditID':e['auditID'],'verb':e['verb'],'level':e['level'],'central_matches':len(rows)})
print('verified_event_count',len(local))
PY
